voice_en: Tests, oral answers and procedures. In one app?
NurseGuide is a study app for nurses and mid-level medical staff.
Five new questions every day, with an explanation and a source after each answer.
Knowledge and Skills Assessment: tests, oral tickets and work on your mistakes, all in one section.
Choose your direction. Exam mode has a timer. Practice mode shows the answer right away.
Draw an oral ticket and check yourself against the answer plan.
Step-by-step procedure guides, each with its source.
Pick your direction: nursing, midwifery, patronage, X-ray laboratory and more.
Teachers create groups, assign tests and see the results.
Every item shows where it comes from.
The interface is in Uzbek, Russian and English.
